structure.name: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
structure.description: Dataset: CPI. The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures changes in the price of a 'basket' of goods and services which account for a high proportion of expenditure by the CPI population group (i.e. metropolitan households). Unit of measure: Index. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 6401.0

descriptions.en: Dataset: CPI.
